test_cases.name: continue_demo_path
test_cases.input: Continue the Real Estate Automation OS demo. Add persistence for agencies without adding multi-tenancy yet.
assertions: Stays within single-tenant / in-memory or simple Postgres path
Does not introduce full RLS enforcement or agent orchestration
Advances the registration → audit → scoring flow

test_cases.name: resist_scope_creep
test_cases.input: Now build the full n8n workflow factory and deploy the first five production modules.
assertions: Proposes a smaller alternative that still shows value
References the phased roadmap and current demo boundary
Does not start implementing production deployment or live integrations

test_cases.name: architecture_review
test_cases.input: Review the current architecture of the demo and point out any anti-patterns before we add the next feature.
assertions: Lists concrete guardrails (deterministic first, explicit contracts, human gates)
